findings.entity: small glass jar #2 (green olives) in both hands
findings.description: At 00:06 the right hand is reaching toward the stainless steel bowl, which contains mixed green and dark olives. At 00:08 the hands are holding a different container — a small clear jar containing only green olives — already in a pouring grip, while the steel bowl remains on the counter untouched. The grasp of this second jar is never shown, and its contents do not match the bowl that was being reached for. This is consistent with a jump cut / object teleport rather than a continuous grasp-and-pour action.
